5929-6871-6879-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
5929-6871-6879-8095.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Repeat from step 3.

5900-6719-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
5900-6719-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

323-678-5670--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
323-678-5670--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1479-2841-4488-8101.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-4488-8101.description:
Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-2178-5173-6095.easyPrerequisites:
Zul Ashur, Lich Lord does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zul Ashur.
728-2178-5173-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting Shambling Ghast.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambing Ghast dies, it and Zul Ashur trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zul Ashur trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4091-5704-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
4091-5704-7791.description:
Activate Leafkin Avenger by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Leafkin Avenger.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Leafkin Avenger.
Repeat.

670-1619-5887-6147.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-5887-6147.description:
Cast Werefox Bodyguard by paying its mana cost.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Rilsa Rael until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, causing Rilsa Rael to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Rilsa Rael enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Rilsa Rael trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Werefox Bodyguard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Werefox Bodyguard trigger, exiling Rilsa Rael until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Werefox Bodyguard.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

280-1257-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
280-1257-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1903-2539-3094-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
1903-2539-3094-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

104-5086-5183-5231-6705.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-5086-5183-5231-6705.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

3000-4508-5880-7040.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Treasure token
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

851-3484-5391-6774.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
851-3484-5391-6774.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2073-3281-4241.description:
Activate Great Furnace by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Great Furnace to become a creature until end of turn.
Great Furnace dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Great Furnace from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2523-3705-4050-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

5626-5733-6927.manaNeeded: {5}{U} the first turn, with {7}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
5626-5733-6927.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 2 or less.
You have at least {E}.
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
5626-5733-6927.description:
Deal combat damage using a Rogue
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 2 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Damage Control Crew from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Damage Control Crew enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}, sacrificing Damage Control Crew, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3446-5078-6918.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

3836-4316-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

requires.n: Vehicle with MV >= 3 and a Crew Ability

5315-5747-6243--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
5315-5747-6243--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

478-804-2821-3573-4832.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2821-3573-4832.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
478-804-2821-3573-4832.description:
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Tolarian Academy.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 2.

914-5140-5147.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-5140-5147.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}.
Repeat.
914-5140-5147.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

603-4050-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.
603-4050-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1409-5491.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve the Urza trigger, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the Construct and Map, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

1636-3337.notablePrerequisites:
Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
You control at least one additional nonlegendary creature.
1636-3337.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control with haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

656-5220-5243.notablePrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to a creature you control.
656-5220-5243.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Ugin's Conjurant on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2438-2793-3582-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Kaya's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Ugin's Nexus.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Ugin's Nexus triggers, returning itself from exile to your hand, and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 3, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

690-3779-4658.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
690-3779-4658.description:
Cast Swords to Plowshares by paying {W}, exiling Soul of Eternity and gaining life equal to its power.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing target opponent whose lifetotal is less than or equal to Soul of Eternity's power to lose life equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1082-3991.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Faceless Butcher enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Dual Nature's first ability.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, choosing not to exile anything.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher.
The token Faceless Butcher enters the battlefield, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, triggering Dual Nature's second ability, exiling the Faceless Butcher token.
The Faceless Butcher token leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning the nontoken Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

628-1495.notablePrerequisites: Triskelion has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
628-1495.description:
If Triskelion has at least three +1/+1 counters on it, activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 1 until there are two +1/+1 counters remaining on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from Triskelion, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Repeat step 3 an additional time.
Triskelion dies.
Triskelion's undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

64-2665-3617.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Warden of the Eye.
64-2665-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye.
When the token Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
